excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, short black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a light red tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, red shorts and black hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_5 uses a precision picking tool to work through ironstone matrix rich with shimmering pyrite gold grains, slowly exposing the hydrofocal fin bones of an ichthyosaur, Stenopterygius, at an excavation site. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
